title: Recursive AI Engineering
goal: Evolve RAE into a recursively growing, context-efficient engineering system that operates through one manually started GPT conversation at a time.
summary: Initial tree bootstrap. Existing Supabase project/task/execution model remains authoritative. Current work establishes repository-local recursive context nodes, lazy loading, bounded upward summaries, branch wake-up, and cross-session checkpoints. The current main branch still contains fixed Coordinator startup wording; open PR #26 adds a mandatory separate-session role chain and conflicts with the confirmed single-session runtime boundary.

evidence_refs.note: Current startup contract requires project queue enumeration and describes each conversation as a temporary coordinator/executor.
Current architecture uses project-scoped task queues and parent/child task decomposition.
Open proposal requires fixed role identities and a distinct GPT session for review; conflicts with the Owner-confirmed runtime boundary.
